files.use: separate exploratory positional analysis only (exon 3, July 7/9)

experimental_metadata.Read me!A2: Gels 7-7 and 7-9 · complete raw exports, quantification and microwalk summary · no figures
experimental_metadata.Read me!B5: Summary; Quantification; Raw 7-7; Raw 7-9; Methods. No figures or chart objects included.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B7: Alternative splicing of exon 3 on the human SMN2 super minigene (SMN2Sup). 18-mer ASO microwalk across exon 3, all treatments at 5 nM, so ASO target position is the single variable. cDNA RT-PCR products resolved by PAGE and quantified by densitometry in GelAnalyzer.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B8: Gel 7-7: ladder, Super Minigene Only, ScrMOE (scrambled control), ASOs A–E. Gel 7-9: ladder, ASOs F–K.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B9: All 9 original columns and every reported row are included: 27 rows for 7-7 and 27 for 7-9 (15 ladder rows plus sample rows on each). Labels and numeric values are retained as exported.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B10: Experimenter confirmed the exports are complete. Super Minigene Only and ScrMOE have no Band 2 row, so excluded volume is 0 in calculations. No artificial band rows are added to the raw tables.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B11: Ψ (%) = 100 × Band 1 / (Band 1 + Band 2) and Δ3 (%) = 100 × Band 2 / (Band 1 + Band 2), using raw band volumes. Band 1 (upper band) = exon 3 included; Band 2 (lower band) = exon 3 skipped. Ψ + Δ3 = 100 in every lane.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B12: Each ASO was run once (n = 1), so there are no replicate statistics. 100% refers to quantified signal, not to absence of other transcripts. See Methods for the cross-gel caveat.
experimental_metadata.Read me!B13: Only the two uploaded exports are analyzed. ASOs A–K cover nt 2–168 of exon 3.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B5: Ψ (%) = 100 × I/(I+E) and Δ3 (%) = 100 × E/(I+E), using raw integrated band volumes from GelAnalyzer and the supplied band identities. No background re-estimation or fragment-length correction.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B6: Sample Band 1 (upper band) = exon 3 included. Band 2 (lower band) = exon 3 skipped (Δ3). Identities were supplied by the experimenter and are used as given. No product sizes are assumed in any calculation.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B7: Super Minigene Only and ScrMOE have no Band 2 row. The experimenter confirmed the exports are complete, so excluded volume is 0 (highlighted in Quantification). A 100% signal fraction does not exclude undetectable skipped transcript.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B8: Quantification column K compares each computed Ψ with the Band 1 Volume Ratio printed in the export. Differences are limited to rounding of the export's 3-decimal ratio.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B9: Lane values only. Deltas are Ψ minus the ScrMOE lane and Ψ minus the Super Minigene Only lane, in percentage points. nt start and end come from the ASO labels.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B10: One gel per ASO, so n = 1: no mean, SD, paired tests or p-values are computed. Numeric exports alone cannot establish PCR linearity, signal saturation or sample provenance.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B11: The Super Minigene Only and ScrMOE controls are on gel 7-7 only. ASOs F–K (gel 7-9) have no on-gel control, so their deltas compare across gels, which differ in run conditions (band Rf and ladder spacing differ between the two gels). Treat F–K deltas as provisional until a control is run beside them.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B12: For reference only, not used in any calculation: the exports estimate Band 1 at about 548–609 bp and Band 2 at about 286–338 bp, with the two bands about 260–277 bp apart. Estimates shift between gels 7-7 and 7-9.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B13: Product identity rests on the construct-specific primer design used in the experiment.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B14: No reported band rows are dropped. Ladder rows stay in the raw tables and do not enter sample Ψ. Gel 7-7 lane 2 does not appear in the export, so it is not represented.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B15: PDF table text parsed into the original columns. Cal.Volume dashes preserved as text. The Cal.Volume entry for ASO K Band 2 (7-9) was blank in the supplied text and is recorded as '-'. Raw 7-7 and Raw 7-9 retain all original values.
experimental_metadata.Methods!B16: Live Excel formulas include cached values, enabling immediate display without recalculation.
